purpose: Determine whether formal behavioral localization is technically feasible and operationally stable, using CBMC on six LeetCode 704 C++17 seed solvers with frozen family structure, bounds, and success criteria.

problem.name: Binary Search
problem.official_bounds_confirmed: 1 <= nums.length <= 10^4; -10^4 < nums[i], target < 10^4; all integers unique; sorted in ascending order; return index or -1

family.name: target_present
family.predicate: exists i in [0, n): nums[i] == target
family.complement: D minus F: target absent; every solver must return -1 there

failure.definition: An input is a verified failure for a solver if and only if, when executed under the frozen harness, exactly one of the following occurs: (a) the returned int differs from the specification-correct answer (index of target if present, else -1); (b) the process crashes; (c) a memory-safety violation occurs (out-of-bounds access, invalid pointer, undefined behavior instrumented by CBMC bounds/pointer checks); (d) execution exceeds the per-input timeout or does not terminate; (e) output is malformed.

label_definitions.REFUTED: At least one verified failure outside F (in D minus F).
label_definitions.CERTIFIED_LOCALIZED: At least one verified failure inside F, plus a complete formal proof of correctness over all of D minus F (including safety and termination) for that solver.
label_definitions.NO_FAILURE: A complete formal proof of correctness over all of D.
label_definitions.CANDIDATE_ONLY: Verified failure inside F, no verified failure outside F found, and no complete proof of correctness over D minus F.
label_definitions.UNKNOWN: Anything else: timeouts, incomplete unwinding, missing proof obligations, or tool/harness failure.

evidence_flags.in_f_failure_verified: true only when a concrete in-F input has been machine-checked as failing (wrong answer, crash, safety violation, timeout, or nontermination).
evidence_flags.outside_f_failure_verified: true only when a concrete in-D-minus-F input has been machine-checked as failing.
evidence_flags.d_f_proof: "complete" only when the formal proof obligation over D minus F completed with no violated unwinding assertions, all checks passed, within the frozen budget; "incomplete" otherwise.
evidence_flags.full_d_proof: "complete" only when both the in-F exhaustive search completed with no failure found AND d_f_proof is "complete"; "incomplete" otherwise.

immediate_stop_rules: If seed 4, seed 5, or seed 6 receives label CERTIFIED_LOCALIZED, stop the entire study and report the contradiction; do not continue.
If seed 1 receives label UNKNOWN, certification claims for seeds 2 and 3 are also void; record that outcome as a legitimate end state, do not change tools, bounds, or seeds.
If the observed outcome for any seed is UNKNOWN, report it; do not modify tools, bounds, seeds, budgets, or timeouts.
If an independent checker disagrees with classifier.py on any seed, stop and report the disagreement.
success_rule: RLC-0 succeeds only if every one of the six seeds receives its expected outcome from expected.json, every CERTIFIED_LOCALIZED or NO_FAILURE label is backed by a complete proof under the frozen completeness criteria, and the independent checker agrees with classifier.py on all six labels. Acceptance evidence is verdict-specific per expected.json expected_evidence and CONTRACT section 13; incomplete proof obligations on a seed whose expected outcome is REFUTED are expected refutation-side evidence, not missing certificates.
complexity_claim: NONE. The study does not verify O(log n), loop-iteration bounds, or any other complexity property; it certifies functional behavior, memory safety, and termination only. This limitation must appear prominently in REPORT.md.

tier1_exhaustive_small.construction: All strictly-increasing distinct arrays of each length over the value range, crossed with every target in the target range.
tier1_exhaustive_small.closed_form_count: sum over L in 1..6 of C(7, L) times 9 = 126 times 9 = 1134

tier2_adversarial.boundary_case_construction: For each boundary length L: one ascending case [0, 1, ..., L-1] with target L (absent, above max) and one with target 0 (present). For L=10000 the values remain within the domain element range.

random_cases.generator: python3 random.Random(20261012); for each case: L = rng.randint(1, 10000); nums = sorted(rng.sample(range(-9999, 10000), L)); target = rng.randrange(-9999, 10000) if rng.random() < 0.5 else rng.choice(nums)
random_cases.reproducibility: Exact algorithm frozen; any deviation is a protocol violation.

tier2_adversarial.purpose: Refutation only. Tier 2 can produce verified failures but can never produce a certificate.

properties_per_seed: in_f_failure_search: assume F, assert the specification-correct return value; a counterexample is a verified in-F failure and its trace is the witness.
d_f_proof: assume D minus F, assert return == -1 plus safety; SUCCESS with no violated unwinding assertions is a complete D-minus-F proof.
full_d_proof: additionally assume F and assert the correct return across the whole domain; used for seed 1's NO_FAILURE claim.

harness_model.array: fixed capacity 10000 with symbolic length n constrained to [1, 10000]
harness_model.elements: symbolic ints; for all i < j < n: nums[i] < nums[j]; for all i < n: -10000 < nums[i] < 10000
harness_model.assumption_encoding: domain constraints applied via __CPROVER_assume; family membership encoded as a dedicated assume for the F and D-minus-F properties

completeness_criteria: cbmc exit status SUCCESS for the proof obligation
all bounds, pointer, and undefined-behavior checks passed
domain assumptions exactly encode D (or D minus F) as specified above
the property is actually asserted (not vacuous by construction)
completed within the frozen wall-clock and memory budget
tier3_cbmc.incomplete_action: Any failed criterion yields UNKNOWN for that obligation; never a certificate.

msvc.cl_version: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.51.36260 for x64
msvc.developer_prompt: Visual Studio 2026 Developer Command Prompt v18.10.2 (VsDevCmd.bat -arch=amd64 -host_arch=amd64)
msvc.stl: MSVC 14.51.36231 (native Tier 1/2 path only; NOT parseable by CBMC 6.11.0, see ADDENDUM_2026-10-13)

model_route.mechanism: goto-cl /I rlc0\model resolves #include <vector> to the project-controlled model before the system INCLUDE path; shadow proven by cl /EP preprocessing of a canary (model marker rlc0_size_t present, MSVC STL marker integral_constant absent)
model_route.index_precondition: operator[] asserts i < size() via __CPROVER_assert on the CBMC path; the assertion is a verification monitor for the study's memory-safety failure category, not a claim about std::vector's ordinary in-bounds behavior
model_route.cprover_assert_declaration: must be declared extern "C" in the model header or CBMC reports 'no body for callee' (C++ mangling breaks builtin binding); __CPROVER__ is predefined by goto-cl
model_route.goto_cl_output_quirk: goto-cl silently produces no artifact for /Fe:file and /Fo:file (colon forms); use default output naming (goto-binary written as <name>.exe) or attached non-colon forms; frozen commands use default naming

toolchain.not_in_frozen_toolchain: llvm-mingw clang++ 23.1.1 was installed during toolchain inventory and verified working for native C++17 compilation; it is NOT part of the frozen RLC-0 toolchain. All native Tier 1/2 executions use cl.exe.

semantic_correspondence.principle: Certificates are properties of programs built against rlc0/model/vector on the CBMC path. Correspondence to std::vector for the operations the seeds use is an explicit proof obligation, never assumed.

obligations.statement: Operation coverage: a machine-checked scan of the six seeds establishes exactly which vector members they use (expected: construction, size(), operator[]). The model implements precisely those with cppreference-defined semantics for valid in-bounds inputs.
obligations.verification: grep-level scan of seed sources against the model's public member list, recorded before freeze; any unimplemented member used by a seed is a stop condition.

obligations.statement: Behavioral agreement on defined, in-bounds executions: the same canary/harness logic built twice natively with cl (real MSVC STL vs model header) must agree on return values and crash/termination behavior for every in-bounds operation invocation. The bounds assertion is NOT part of ordinary-behavior comparison; it is the explicit monitor for the study's out-of-bounds failure category.
obligations.verification: dual-build native comparison over the frozen case sets (Tier 1 + Tier 2 + witnesses) in Phase B; any disagreement stops the study. Required BEFORE final freeze per review condition 1.

obligations.statement: CBMC-path coverage: the model's index precondition assert plus CBMC bounds/pointer checks cover every memory-safety violation real operator[] would permit on the declared domain.
obligations.verification: negative canary evidence (model assert fires on v[v.size()] with backing buffer in bounds) plus the frozen flag set on every invocation; documented in FREEZE.md.

full_domain_harness_audit.requirement: Before any NO_FAILURE or CERTIFIED_LOCALIZED label, the proof harness must be audited to confirm it represents the entire declared LC704 domain (symbolic length n in [1,10000], symbolic elements with strict-increase and range constraints, symbolic target), not finite pilot cases or boundary samples.
full_domain_harness_audit.finite_evidence_rule: Tier 1/2 execution over 1134 + ~242 inputs is refutation-side evidence only and can never substitute for a completed proof obligation with full unwinding.
full_domain_harness_audit.verification: documented harness review recorded in the Phase B evidence; incomplete unwinding or violated unwinding assertions always yield UNKNOWN, never a certificate.

authorization.freeze_gate: No seed may be compiled, executed, or submitted to CBMC until rlc0/FREEZE.md records SHA-256 hashes of every frozen file, the exact tool versions, and the git commit; the rlc0-freeze tag exists; and the tag commit hash is recorded.
authorization.execution: Phase C (single execution over the six seeds) is authorized only after the freeze gate.
authorization.follow_up: None. The report must end with: RLC-0 is complete. No follow-up is authorized.
